threadDescriptions.folding-baseboard: Construct a folding baseboard for the portable tram layout
threadDescriptions.tram-repaint: Repaint model tram 62 in the cream-and-russet scheme
threadDescriptions.exhibition-crate: Build and fit a transport crate for the tram layout
threadDescriptions.station-announcements: Make a playable announcement soundtrack for the tram layout

items.text: Portable tram board hinge test: track joints need locating pins as well as the piano hinge. Otherwise the two halves shift when opened.
items.rationale: Structural alignment of the folding railway base.

items.text: Tram 62 paint notes: cream above the waist, russet below. Mask the number plates so their raised edges remain sharp.
items.rationale: Defines the vehicle repaint scheme.

items.text: Gutter above the kitchen spills at the bracket. Ladder view shows moss blocking the outlet; clear it before deciding the joint is cracked.
items.rationale: Household rainwater repair.

items.text: Transport crate drawing allows 18 mm foam all round the folded tram board. Put carrying handles near the balance point, not the centre of the lid.
items.rationale: Protective case design for exhibition transport.

items.text: Announcement audio: 'Next stop, Market Hall.' Record it dry, then add a little loudspeaker crackle. Need a separate button for the depot departure.
items.rationale: Content and playback requirements for the layout soundtrack.

items.text: Baseboard alignment pin holes drilled. With the halves open there is a 1 mm rail-height mismatch at the hinge; shim the right subframe.
items.rationale: Adjusts the folding base construction.

items.text: Paint test on spare tram shell: the russet dries nearly black. Mix one part ochre into three parts russet before spraying number 62.
items.rationale: Colour preparation for the specified repaint.

items.text: Crate correction: 18 mm foam squeezes the folded board's cable plugs. Use 10 mm on the plug side and move that wall out 8 mm; replace the first drawing.
items.rationale: Revises the earlier crate dimensions and lining.

items.text: Need another hinge? The lid still leans.
items.rationale: No object identifies whether this concerns transport hardware or another lid.

items.text: House gutter outlet cleared. Water now runs freely, but the seam drips. Take a dry close-up for the repair shop.
items.rationale: Continues gutter diagnosis after clearing debris.

items.text: Fit check for the portable layout: move the baseboard latch 12 mm inward so it misses the crate foam. Mark a matching recess in the transport case, then test closing the crate with both board halves securely latched.
items.rationale: Requires coordinated modifications to both the baseboard and its case.

items.text: Tram 62 first cream coat covered well. Remove masking before it gets brittle; leave the russet panel to cure overnight.
items.rationale: Execution of the vehicle paint job.

items.text: Market Hall take three is clearest. Trim the breath before 'Next' and make the depot clip the same loudness.
items.rationale: Audio editing of the announcement recordings.

items.text: Baseboard opens flat after the shim. Run a tram slowly over the hinged rail joints before adding street paving.
items.rationale: Tests construction alignment under rolling stock.

items.text: Transport handles arrived with short screws. Buy bolts with washers; the crate will carry the whole folded tram layout and must not rely on screws into plywood edges.
items.rationale: Corrects transport-case hardware selection.

items.text: Sealant receipt, kitchen gutter seam. Applied after drying; check the outlet and seam during the next rain.
items.rationale: Documents the household gutter repair.

items.text: Bring the cream sample tomorrow.
items.rationale: A colour reference without an object cannot safely identify the tram repaint.

items.text: Announcement player test: one press starts one clip; holding the button no longer repeats the departure message endlessly.
items.rationale: Playback behavior validation for the soundtrack.

items.text: Tram 62 lettering sealed with satin varnish. Small brush mark by the rear number can stay; don't strip a sound finish for that.
items.rationale: Finishes and accepts the repaint.

items.text: Closed-crate shake test: no movement of the folded layout. Add arrows showing which side faces up in the exhibition van.
items.rationale: Final transport protection check and handling labels.

undo.reason: Hypothetical correction: this spare shell is a paint test for tram 62, not protective packing material.
